description: Single source mapping between the JavaScript commit-message gate steps and their Rust (Taxis kernel) counterparts. Every step registered under `commit-msg` in gate-step-registry.json must appear here exactly once; every entry must point at a Rust rule registered in rule-catalog.json or declare itself not-applicable with a reason. Consumed by validate-commit-rule-coverage.js.

covers: trailing ASCII or fullwidth period forbidden
optional breaking marker ! before or after scope
entries.notes: Rust currently uses str::len() (UTF-8 bytes) for header bounds; must switch to chars().count() before this entry can move to implemented (decision C-07).

covers: inline code block and URL masking
entries.notes: Rust currently does substring contains() with no word boundary, no whitelist, no masking; `temp` wrongly matches `template`.

covers: blank second line between header and body
consecutive blank lines inside body forbidden
minimum substantive characters for critical types
minimum substantive characters for non critical types
per-section substantive floors: Why 15, Fixed 12, Verification 12
unresolved markers TODO FIXME TBD XXX and Chinese equivalents
required semantic slots: project, why, change, verification
refactor and perf commit require Changed slot
breaking header requires Breaking Changes slot
ASCII hyphen and space list markers only
entries.notes: Rust matches required_sections by literal name, so `[Project / 项目归属]` and `[动机]` are falsely rejected.
Rust uses substring matching for allowed_projects, so `fractal-git-evil` passes.

covers: construction batch codenames: phaseN, stN, pN, sprint N, wN, pass N
rule identifiers quoted in the message must exist in rule-catalog.json
entries.notes: Rust has no rule-id anti-hallucination check at all; a fabricated ABC-XYZ-999 currently commits.

entries.reason: Driven by commit-style-arbiter.js Shannon token entropy and bilingual verb taxonomy. Reproducing a statistical language model inside the kernel gate would make verdicts depend on corpus tuning rather than a falsifiable predicate, so the kernel deliberately does not replicate it. The kernel keeps only the deterministic subset: FGT-MSG-004 vocabulary and FGT-MSG-005 structure.

covers: structural exemption for genuinely generated merge commits
entries.notes: Rust currently skips message validation for merge entirely rather than granting a recorded exemption. Design decision C-05 requires parent-count evidence, not header text matching.

kernelOnly.reason: Kernel-only subdivision of empty-section and bullet-floor checks; retained as a separate identifier so a failure names the specific predicate.
Declaration-to-diff symbol anchoring. No JavaScript counterpart exists; this is a kernel-only capability.
Policy downgrade attempt interception. No JavaScript counterpart exists because the global gate has no policy tier concept.
Kernel-only subdivision of unresolved markers and template placeholders.
